title: Turnkey Steel Building Solution in Pakistan | Steel Mind Engineers
description: One contract from design to handover. Steel Mind Engineers handles engineering, fabrication, painting, delivery and erection of PEB projects in Pakistan.
keyword: turnkey steel building solution in Pakistan
support: design and build steel structures Pakistan
h1: One-Step Solution: A Turnkey Steel Building From Design to Handover
quickAnswer: The one-step solution means one company and one contract for the whole steel building: design, 3D approval, detailing, fabrication, painting, delivery, erection and support after handover.
alt: Eight-stage turnkey process for a pre-engineered steel building.

faq.q: Who is my contact during the project?
faq.a: A project coordinator is your single point of contact from contract to handover.
Yes. Steel Mind Engineers also supplies fabricated steel to your drawings. See Custom Steel Fabrication.

blocks.text: Many steel projects use a separate designer, a separate fabricator and a separate erection contractor. When something goes wrong, each one blames the other. Steel Mind Engineers does all of the work with one team, so you have one contract and one person to call.

items.name: Requirement review
items.text: An engineer studies your use, size, site and budget.

items.name: Design and 3D concept
items.text: The structure is designed and you approve the model.

items.name: Fabrication
items.text: The factory cuts, welds and assembles the parts.

items.name: Delivery
items.text: Parts are packed in erection order and sent to your site.

items.name: Erection
items.text: Site crews assemble the building and fit sheeting and accessories.

items.name: Handover and after sale support
items.text: You receive the finished building and support for later work.

blocks.text: You save time because the design team and the workshop talk every day. You reduce risk because one company is responsible for the result. You also receive a clear schedule from the start.

You provide the site, access for trucks and cranes, and the foundation, unless the contract says otherwise. The engineer gives you the anchor bolt plan so that your foundation contractor can match the steel exactly.
